integrity: The infinite theorem is proved symbolically. Exhaustive finite power-automaton computations are supporting checks only and are not used to infer the all-n statement.
scientific_limitations: The result is proved for the standard labeled Wielandt family W_n with n>=3. Originality remains subject to the residual possibility of an older equivalent statement under subset-reachability or total-extension terminology.
title: Exact \(k\)-avoiding thresholds of the Wielandt automata
